title: element:text prints its declared "Text or Markdown content" verbatim: a Markdown link or **bold** in content renders as typed
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2918 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2937) wanted the pricing page's sales address as a link inside its footer sentence. Because the console prints `element:text` Markdown verbatim, it had to become a separate link-variant button. The behaviour was measured on cloud staging on 2026-10-13: `[a](mailto:a)` and `**b**` came out exactly as typed. That reading is recorded at cloud `packages/service-tenant/src/pages/welcome.page.ts` L212–214. Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectui issue names `element:text` with Markdown, or `ElementTextRenderer`.

## The gap
- The spec declares `ElementTextPropsSchema.content` as "Text or Markdown content" (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`).
- objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx` L156–177 (at `ef71a09f`) prints `pickLocalized(content)` verbatim inside the tag, with no Markdown pass.

Seam: spec `ElementTextPropsSchema.content` → renderer `ElementTextRenderer`.

## Done when
Either:
- `element:text` renders the declared Markdown subset (links, emphasis) safely, with no raw HTML, and a test pins a link and bold text; or
- the spec retires "or Markdown" from the description, so the declaration matches what is rendered (declare-means-enforce).
